title: Climbing rope
description: Make your climbs easier with this rope !
body:
![climbing rope by kheyde](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1baa9a55ed842f8ca22a58154af65948d49c7acf.png)

Have you ever found yourself in a cave entrance with a dizzying drop? And found a bucket of water rather cumbersome to use on your adventures ? This mod adds climbing ropes ! Easy to craft and use, simply right-click on the underside of a block to unwind the rope ! Recyclable, eco-friendly, and cheap ! A true ally !

> ![craft rope](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de549398a0d8b98022819d6f4d2e1e86060bd920.png)
